landing.title: Find the career that actually fits you
landing.subtitle: Masar analyses your school grades, EmSAT scores, interests and personality, and returns ten ranked careers in the UAE job market — each with a plain explanation of why, the skills you still need, and a learning plan to get there.
landing.demoNote: Prefer to look first? Try the demo account student@masar.ae / Demo@1234
landing.step1Body: Emirate, school, grade level and your MOE track: General, Advanced or Elite.
landing.step2Body: Nine MOE subjects, plus your EmSAT scores if you have them. EmSAT is optional.
landing.step3Body: Thirty Holland RIASEC interest items and twenty-five Big Five personality items.
landing.step4Body: Ranked careers, a skill-gap chart, a four-phase learning roadmap and a PDF report.
landing.f1Body: Every match tells you which of your grades, interests or traits produced it. No black box.
landing.f2Body: See your estimated level against what each career actually requires, skill by skill.
landing.f3Body: Specific courses from 120 options — free and paid, Arabic and English, global and UAE providers.
landing.f4Body: Ask about any career, salary, university pathway or skill, in English or Arabic, at any hour.
landing.f5Body: MOE tracks, EmSAT, UAE universities, AED salary ranges and the national strategies each career serves.
landing.f6Body: Download your full profile and plan as a bilingual PDF for your parents or your counsellor.
landing.sectorsSubtitle: Every career in Masar maps onto a sector the UAE is actively building.
landing.ctaFinalTitle: Your path starts with fifteen minutes
landing.ctaFinalBody: No cost, no commitment. You can stop after any step and come back later.

about.title: About Masar AI
about.methodIntro: Masar combines two models rather than relying on one, because neither answers the whole question on its own.
about.m1Body: A Random Forest trained on 5,000 generated student profiles predicts which of the fifteen sectors fits a student. Logistic Regression and K-Nearest Neighbours were trained as baselines for comparison.
about.m2Body: Each career has an ideal profile vector. We compare the student's twenty-dimensional profile against it with a mean-centred cosine similarity, which ranks individual careers inside and across sectors.
about.m3Body: The final score is 45% classifier, 45% similarity and 10% labour-market demand. Demand is capped deliberately: a guidance system that chases fashion would recreate the problem it exists to solve.
about.m4Body: For each match we surface the three profile dimensions that contributed most, and only where the student and the career are both strong — a shared strength, never a shared absence.
about.dataBody: No public dataset links UAE school grades, RIASEC interests and Big Five traits to career outcomes. Rather than claim one, Masar ships a deterministic synthetic dataset generator with a documented causal story, and states its limits openly. High accuracy on this data demonstrates that the pipeline works — not that the recommendations are externally validated.

wizard.title: Your profile
wizard.subtitle: Four steps. Everything is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back.
wizard.s2Help: Enter your most recent grade for each subject. Leave a subject blank if you do not take it.
wizard.emsatHelp: Scores are on the official 500–1500 band. Leave blank if you have not sat the test.
wizard.s3Help: Thirty statements. There are no right answers — pick what is true for you, not what sounds impressive.
wizard.s4Help: Twenty-five statements. Answer quickly; your first reaction is usually the honest one.
wizard.mustAnswerAll: Please answer every statement before continuing.
